channel.description: Latest articles from Ink Free News (inkfreenews.com)

item.title: Indiana Leaders Express Sympathies At Death Of Rep. Baird’s Wife
item.description: Condolences poured in following the death of U.S. Rep. Jim Baird’s wife nearly two months after they were injured in a car crash.

item.title: Whitko Names Students Of The Month For March
item.description: The following Whitko Community School students have been named Students of the Month for March 2026.

item.title: Reboot Thursdays In Warsaw Help Veterans, First Responders Overcome Trauma, Mental Health Struggles
item.description: Bowen Health and American Legion Post 49 will be hosting Reboot Thursdays to help not only veterans but first responders within the community overcome trauma and mental health struggles through faith-based, peer-led programs.

item.title: Bill Targeting Low-Earning College Degrees Clears Indiana Legislature
item.description: A last-day vote in the Indiana Legislature advanced a controversial provision allowing the state to scrutinize and potentially eliminate college degree programs tied to low earnings, despite warnings from some lawmakers that the policy risks undermining essential but often underpaid professions.

item.title: Voters Have Say On Fort Wayne-Area Casino Under Approved Plan
item.description: Voters in three Fort Wayne-area counties would decide whether a new casino could land there under a bill that’s cleared the General Assembly.

item.title: Cost Caps Central To Medicaid Long-term Care Bill Clear Legislature
item.description: A Medicaid bill reshaping parts of Indiana’s long-term care system cleared the legislature a final time Friday, Feb. 27 and now heads to Gov. Mike Braun.

item.title: Warsaw Teenager Arrested For Residential Entry
item.description: A Warsaw teenager was arrested for allegedly entering a home in Burket without permission.

item.title: Lawmakers Eye Executive Order Costs In Bill On Its Way To Governor
item.description: The financial hit from each of an Indiana governor’s executive orders would be tallied up within a week under heavily edited legislation on its way to Gov. Mike Braun’s desk.

item.title: Last-Minute Attempt To Revive Hemp Drug Ban Fails
item.description: Indiana’s prohibition on intoxicating and synthetic hemp-derived drugs was dead for less than a week before it was resurrected and killed again - this time, until at least next year.

item.title: Resignation, Summer Programming, Proposed Milford Park Headline Wawasee Work Session
item.description: A surprise resignation, updates on summer programming and discussion of a proposed collaborative park in Milford highlighted the Wawasee School Board's Monday, March 2 work session.
